source: swisstopo with Swiss Post — Amtliches Ortschaftenverzeichnis mit Postleitzahl und Perimeter (official directory of localities with postcodes, open data)
selection: A postal code is listed only when every directory row for it names the same canton and the same locality (Swiss Post canton suffix stripped). Left out: 169 codes spanning several cantons, 510 codes shared by several localities, 13 codes without a canton (Liechtenstein).
